name: Jog Runter (hold)
format:
<md-button class="md-raised" style="background:#2196f3;color:#fff;width:100%;margin:0"
  ng-mousedown="send({payload:1, topic:'jog_down'})"
  ng-mouseup="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_down'})"
  ng-mouseleave="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_down'})"
  touchstart="send({payload:1, topic:'jog_down'})"
  touchend="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_down'})">▼ JOG -</md-button>

name: Jog Hoch (hold)
format:
<md-button class="md-raised" style="background:#2196f3;color:#fff;width:100%;margin:0"
  ng-mousedown="send({payload:1, topic:'jog_up'})"
  ng-mouseup="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_up'})"
  ng-mouseleave="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_up'})"
  touchstart="send({payload:1, topic:'jog_up'})"
  touchend="send({payload:0, topic:'jog_up'})">▲ JOG +</md-button>
